notes.title: v1.0.5
notes.notes:
Kia ora!

I had some feedback that the interactions with the Pet Gob seemed unclear. 
To address this I increased the volume of its purr and success meow, as well as improving the tutorial text and animation. 

Thank you to everyone who has played the game and even more so to those who have reviewed! Hitting 10 reviews is a crucial point for spreading the game on steam so consider helping out by reviewing if you haven't already.

Let me know if you have any other feedback!

Until then, I shall return to the enchanted forest where I sit on moss and develop games. 
I have a few projects in the works, a few goblin themed and a few not.

Thanks,
Jack // nobones

notes.title: BONK THE GOBLINS! is Live!
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who is checking out Bonk The Goblins! 
The most important thing you can do for the game is leave a review! 

I'm very excited to get the game into people's hands!
If you encounter any bugs either email me or report it in the game's discussions. I'll do my best to fix them! 

I am exhausted from hustling to finish the game right now, but after a rest I may add some extra things to the game if people are interested. For now, enjoy the different goblin types and figuiring out how to get G rank.

Please leave a review and tell any friends or weirdly rich children to try out the game.

Jack // nobones
